segments.text: The sea ice of the Arctic is rapidly melting
The evidence shown by satellite photos is shocking
What was once white is giving way to blue ocean
One area after another, scientists had not predicted such rapid change
Ten years ago, models had estimated that the kind of ice retreat we see now
would happen around 2050
But reality is advancing at a pace far beyond the prediction
The primary cause is the emission of greenhouse gases from human activity
At the same time, melting land ice and warming oceans are raising sea levels
Small pacific island nations such as Tuvalu and Kiribati are already facing the crisis of being submerged
Their residents may eventually be forced to leave their homelands
The Arctic has its own unique ecosystem Polar bears, Arctic foxes, seals
If the ice disappears, these animals lose their habitat
And face the threat of extinction Even more serious is the release of vast amounts
Some methane gas that had been trapped in the permafrost
This has many times the warming effect of carbon dioxide
And accelerates warming governments have set out committee after committee
And representatives debate countermeasures
The reaching agreement to contain the problem is not easy
The earth is the home of all of us
It is not someone else's problem
If we do not act now
What will be destroyed is the dwelling of future generations
